text:
incident-bot: ALERT — spike in 5xx from edge in eu-west-1: 15% error rate over 3m, predominant error = TLS handshake failures (ssl: alert handshake failure). Paging oncall.

maria (oncall): on it. pulling graphs -> 
`sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="edge-proxy",region="eu-west-1",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (status)` shows 5xx spike starting 07:12 UTC.

chang: seeing repeated nginx logs: `SSL_do_handshake() failed (SSL: error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert unknown ca) from 10.10.2.45:51234` on edge instances behind lb-eu-01.

simon: customers report requests failing with `TLS handshake error` and our gateway returning 525-like gateway error. Support queue getting ~10 reports from enterprise tenants in eu. tagging support_lead.

support_lead: escalated to CS tier 1->2. Which clusters affected? any dedicated nodes?

maria (oncall): primarily traffic through lb-eu-01 -> edge-pool-eu-1 (hostnames: edge1.eu.redwood.internal, edge2). Dedicated customers on dedicated pools unaffected so far. I'll grep cert metadata.

maria (oncall): quick check: `openssl s_client -connect edge1.eu.redwood.internal:443 -servername api.redwood.com -showcerts` returns only leaf cert, missing intermediate chain. clients enforcing full chain fail.

chang: root cause hypothesis: automated cert renewal job ran at 06:58 UTC and uploaded cert to S3 bucket, but chain concatenation step failed (empty intermediate file), then deploy-bot rolled cert to load balancers.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: cert-update/eu-west-1 at 07:01 UTC by cert-renewer (job id: cr-2026-045). Rolling deploy completed across all LBs.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigation options: 1) re-upload full chain and trigger lb config reload (fast), 2) roll back to previous cert version (safer but requires signed key available), 3) enable fallback to allow incomplete chains (risky). leaning to re-upload full chain.

chang: I've got the correct bundle on staging from 06:50 (bundle id: cert-bundle-2026-06-22-0650.pem). copying now.

simon: If we re-upload, do we need to restart nginx on edges? LB supports hot-reload of certs (sni reload) without dropping connections. Plan: push bundle to S3 path `s3://certs/eu/live/current.pem` then run `lbctl reload lb-eu-01 --cert s3://certs/eu/live/current.pem` which calls the HAProxy API to update certs.

maria (oncall): chang please push the bundle and kick the reload, I'll watch metrics. Also open KMS audit to ensure key wasn't rotated incorrectly.

chang: pushing now... `aws s3 cp cert-bundle-2026-06-22-0650.pem s3://certs/eu/live/current.pem --acl bucket-owner-full-control`

ops-bot: INFO: s3 upload complete (s3://certs/eu/live/current.pem) 

chang: triggering reload: `lbctl reload lb-eu-01 --cert s3://certs/eu/live/current.pem --inplace`

deploy-bot: LB reload job started (job id: lb-reload-789).

maria (oncall): metrics starting to improve at 07:18 UTC. 5xx down from 15% -> 3% in 4 minutes. watching error logs to confirm handshake errors go away.

chang: nginx error logs show handshake failure counts dropping. `grep SSL_do_handshake /var/log/nginx/error.log | wc -l` shows decreasing trend.

support_lead: CS update: notified affected customers about mitigation and ETA for resolution. We're marking incident as partial outage for eu-west-1 for 07:12-07:22 UTC for affected tenants.

simon: running full cert chain verify across edge fleet: `for h in $(cat edges-eu.txt); do openssl s_client -connect $h:443 -servername api.redwood.com </dev/null 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,5p' > /tmp/$h.out; done` all nodes returning chain length 3 now.

maria (oncall): closing the urgent pager. setting post-incident tasks: 1) fix renewer job to concat intermediate (PR ready), 2) add pre-deploy check that verifies chain length via openssl, 3) add alert when cert chain length < 2, 4) run audit of previous deploys and confirm no other regions impacted.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigated, error rate back to baseline in eu-west-1.

maria (oncall): handing off to simon for follow-up and RCA. Simon you have the oncall baton till 15:00 UTC. I'll file the incident report.

simon: ack, taking over. quick notes for RCA: cert-renewer job missing intermediate during bundle build (race condition with intermediate-fetch), deploy-bot didn't validate chain before applying. I'll start a postmortem doc and link here.

support_lead: estimated customer impact: 9 enterprise tenants, average successful requests dropped ~12% for the 10-minute window, spike in support tickets but no data exposure. recommending crediting SLA for impacted customers.

maria (oncall): timeline to include in postmortem: 06:58 cert-renewer ran, 07:01 deploy-bot applied incomplete bundle, 07:12 first errors observed and paging, 07:15 mitigation started (upload correct bundle), 07:18 reload started, 07:22 errors returned to baseline.

simon: adding owners for action items: chang -> fix renewer concat PR, ops -> add pre-deploy chain check (will open infra ticket), support -> draft customer SLA credit proposal.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone. I'm marking incident as resolved for the pager but leaving the thread open for RCA notes. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED — pager resolved, follow-up tasks created.
